reviews.title: Would buy again.
reviews.comment: Works well for my SFF 9800x3d build. Easy install and adequate temps during gaming.
reviews.author: JamesM

reviews.title: NZXT best value
reviews.comment: After weeks of research on AIO’s i decided to go with this NZXT Kraken. It felt like this AIO was one of the flagship aio’s on the market and dang does it live up to the hype! The breakaway cable makes cable management super clean and easy. At first i felt like the LCD screen would be too bulky on my Micro-atx board but it looks perfect! And best thing is the temperature display overtop all the gif’s you can choose so it looks nice all while monitoring your CPU/GPU temps in real time!
reviews.author: MichaelM

reviews.title: Expensive but good
reviews.comment: This AIO is absolutely awesome. I got it for my girlfriend and the screen is massive, the 60hz refresh rate really makes it look smooth too. You can customize a ton of the elements on the lcd screen. The aio itself if extremely easy to setup in your pc as it’s ran on only a few cables. Only thing I would say NZXT could do better is pre attach the fans, but that’s a very minuscule complaint.
reviews.author: Jake
